description: Association measures gold standard. Hand-calculated expected values with tolerance=0.01.
notes: PMI = log2((c_xy * N) / (c_x * c_y)). T-score = (c_xy - c_x*c_y/N) / sqrt(c_xy/N). LLR = full 2x2 contingency table formula. Dice = 2*c_xy / (c_x + c_y). All measures return None if any input is 0 or invalid. Trigrams get None for all measures.

cases.description: Strong association — bigram that co-occurs very frequently
Dice coefficient maximum — bigram always co-occurs with itself
Zero c_xy — PMI/tscore are None; dice=0.0; LLR computed from contingency table
cases.notes: PMI/tscore guard c_xy<=0 → None. Dice=2*0/(100+50)=0.0. LLR uses contingency table (o11=0 contributes 0 via safe_log_ratio) ≈ 85.545.

cases.description: PMI with weak association — words co-occur near chance level
n=0 — PMI/LLR/tscore return None; Dice is n-independent and returns 0.5
cases.notes: Dice = 2*5/(10+10) = 0.5; n is not a parameter of compute_dice.
